title: Rav Yosef bar Ami
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Zevachim 3b he raises and resolves a contradiction between a change in the designated offering and a change in its owners: “Did Rava say ...?” Hyman says this should be the reading, citing Dikdukei Soferim. He is mentioned in Kiddushin 23b, explaining the Mishnah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman proposes Rava in the question “Did Rava say...?”, citing דק״ס, conventionally Dikdukei Soferim. The William Davidson vocalized text of Zevachim 3b names Rav Yosef bar Ami as the one raising and resolving the contradiction, but its following question reads Rav. Both the confirmed actor and the differing Rav/Rava readings are preserved.

שינוי קודש concerns a change in the offering’s designation; שינוי בעלים concerns a change in the owner for whom it is offered. The question מי אמר is “Did ... say?”, not “Who said it?” The locators follow Hyman: Zevachim 3b and Kiddushin 23b.
